entityOverrides.description: Verified Account access session clearing path for stale, invalid, expired, deleted-user, and missing-token session candidates.
Verified Account access protected-route guard for Bearer/cookie session acceptance, secret rotation, duplicate cookie precedence, stale session fail-closed behavior, and auth-service outage handling.

Verified Account access controller session clearing path through DB-backed logout and /auth/me route proof, including cleared cookie, stale cookie rejection, stale bearer rejection, and re-login after invalidation.
Verified Account access shared session cookie base options for httpOnly, root path, environment-driven secure flag, and SameSite policy through focused cookie helper tests.

Verified controller cookie clearing through DB-backed logout and /auth/me fail-closed route proof, including cleared token cookie, stale cookie rejection, stale bearer rejection, and deleted or expired session clearing.
Verified login route behavior through DB-backed auth e2e coverage for successful login, remember and non-remember cookie TTLs, public user payload shape, and invalid login error mapping.

Verified logout route behavior through DB-backed auth e2e coverage for sessionVersion invalidation, token cookie clearing, stale cookie rejection, stale bearer rejection, and relogin after invalidation.

Verified current-user route behavior through DB-backed auth e2e coverage for valid session readback, missing token fail-closed behavior, deleted user clearing, expired JWT clearing, duplicate token precedence, and stale session rejection.

Verified register route behavior through DB-backed auth e2e coverage for successful registration, public user payload shape, validation failures, duplicate email rejection, and session cookie bootstrap.
Verified controller session cookie setting through DB-backed register/login/current-user route proof, including remember and short-lived TTLs plus duplicate-cookie healing on /auth/me.

Verified Account access JWT secret resolution through focused auth.jwt tests covering primary signing/verification, previous secret acceptance during the rotation window, and previous secret rejection after expiry.

Verified Account access JWT previous-secret expiry parsing through focused auth.jwt tests covering open-ended previous-secret rotation, valid future expiry acceptance, expired-window rejection, and invalid expiry fail-closed behavior.
